label: Titus 1:1
text: Paul, a servant of my Father, and an apostle of mine, according to the faith of my Father's elect, and the acknowledging of the truth which is after godliness;

label: Titus 1:2
text: In hope of eternal life, which I, that cannot lie, promised before the world began;

label: Titus 1:3
text: But hath in due times manifested my word through preaching, which is committed unto him according to the commandment of my Father, your Saviour;

label: Titus 1:4
text: To Titus, his own son after the common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from my Father, and from me, your Saviour.

label: Titus 1:5
text: For this cause left he thee in Crete, that thou shouldest set in order the things that are wanting, and ordain elders in every city, as he had appointed thee:

label: Titus 1:6
text: If any be blameless, the husband of one wife, having faithful children not accused of riot or unruly.

label: Titus 1:7
text: For a bishop must be blameless, as the steward of my Father; not selfwilled, not soon angry, not given to wine, no striker, not given to filthy lucre;

label: Titus 1:8
text: But a lover of hospitality, a lover of good men, sober, just, holy, temperate;

label: Titus 1:9
text: Holding fast the faithful word as he hath been taught, that he may be able by sound doctrine both to exhort and to convince the gainsayers.

label: Titus 1:10
text: For there are many unruly and vain talkers and deceivers, specially they of the circumcision:

label: Titus 1:11
text: Whose mouths must be stopped, who subvert whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for filthy lucre's sake.

label: Titus 1:12
text: One of themselves, even a prophet of their own, said, The Cretians are alway liars, evil beasts, slow bellies.

label: Titus 1:13
text: This witness is true. Wherefore rebuke them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith;

label: Titus 1:14
text: Not giving heed to Jewish fables, and commandments of men, that turn from the truth.

label: Titus 1:15
text: Unto the pure all things are pure: but unto them that are defiled and unbelieving is nothing pure; but even their mind and conscience is defiled.

label: Titus 1:16
text: They profess that they know my Father; but in works they deny him, being abominable, and disobedient, and unto every good work reprobate.

label: Titus 2:1
text: But speak thou the things which become sound doctrine:

label: Titus 2:2
text: That the aged men be sober, grave, temperate, sound in faith, in charity, in patience.

label: Titus 2:3
text: The aged women likewise, that they be in behaviour as becometh holiness, not false accusers, not given to much wine, teachers of good things;

label: Titus 2:4
text: That they may teach the young women to be sober, to love their husbands, to love their children,

label: Titus 2:5
text: To be discreet, chaste, keepers at home, good, obedient to their own husbands, that the word of my Father be not blasphemed.

label: Titus 2:6
text: Young men likewise exhort to be sober minded.

label: Titus 2:7
text: In all things shewing thyself a pattern of good works: in doctrine shewing uncorruptness, gravity, sincerity,

label: Titus 2:8
text: Sound speech, that cannot be condemned; that he that is of the contrary part may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say of you.

label: Titus 2:9
text: Exhort servants to be obedient unto their own masters, and to please them well in all things; not answering again;

label: Titus 2:10
text: Not purloining, but shewing all good fidelity; that they may adorn the doctrine of my Father, your Saviour, in all things.

label: Titus 2:11
text: For my grace that bringeth salvation hath appeared to all men,

label: Titus 2:12
text: Teaching you that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, ye should live soberly, righteously, and godly, in this present world;

label: Titus 2:13
text: Looking for that blessed hope, and the glorious appearing of me, the great God and your Saviour;

label: Titus 2:14
text: I gave myself for you, that I might redeem you from all iniquity, and purify unto myself a peculiar people, zealous of good works.

label: Titus 2:15
text: These things speak, and exhort, and rebuke with all authority. Let no man despise thee.

label: Titus 3:1
text: Put them in mind to be subject to principalities and powers, to obey magistrates, to be ready to every good work,

label: Titus 3:2
text: To speak evil of no man, to be no brawlers, but gentle, shewing all meekness unto all men.

label: Titus 3:3
text: For ye yourselves also were sometimes foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving divers lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.

label: Titus 3:4
text: But after that the kindness and love of my Father, your Saviour, toward man appeared,

label: Titus 3:5
text: Not by works of righteousness which ye have done, but according to his mercy he saved you, by the washing of regeneration, and renewing of the Holy Ghost;

label: Titus 3:6
text: Which he shed on you abundantly through me, your Saviour;

label: Titus 3:7
text: That being justified by his grace, ye should be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.

label: Titus 3:8
text: This is a faithful saying, and these things he willed that thou affirm constantly, that they which have believed in my Father might be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable unto men.

label: Titus 3:9
text: But avoid foolish questions, and genealogies, and contentions, and strivings about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.

label: Titus 3:10
text: A man that is an heretick after the first and second admonition reject;

label: Titus 3:11
text: Knowing that he that is such is subverted, and sinneth, being condemned of himself.

label: Titus 3:12
text: When he shall send Artemas unto thee, or Tychicus, be diligent to come unto him to Nicopolis: for he hath determined there to winter.

label: Titus 3:13
text: Bring Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey diligently, that nothing be wanting unto them.

label: Titus 3:14
text: And let his also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses, that they be not unfruitful.

label: Titus 3:15
text: All that are with him salute thee. Greet them that love him in the faith. Grace be with you all. Amen. It was written to Titus, ordained the first bishop of the church of the Cretians, from Nicopolis of Macedonia.
